newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg expects sales, earnings growth in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg expects sales, earnings growth in Q2.

text.p: U.S. cereal manufacturer Kellogg Co said Friday its business trends are favorable and it expects sales and earnings growth to return in the second quarter.
On Friday it reported lower first quarter earnings of $0.77 a share, compared with $0.99 a year ago before a $0.03 charge. The company had previously forecast lower earnings.

"We believe our global strategy, including continued aggressive development of both our cereal and convenience foods businesses, new-product leadership, and improved efficiency throughout our operations, has positioned the company to return to solid long-term growth," Chairman Arnold Langbo said in a statement.
